notes.title: Prologue release in 3 days
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I am excited to share that The Last King prologue (FREE) is going to be released on 10th Jan.
Please check the game out, it is inspired by the Greek Persian wars and the movie 300.

It is an action RPG war game. I hope you like it.

Cheers ! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1118040/The_Last_King_Prologue]The Last King Prologue[/url]

notes.title: The Last King Prologue demo release
notes.notes:
Hey everybody !
I have been working on the last king for quite some time and I prepared a special prologue so that you all can try the story that happened before the main game.
In the prologue you will be the king of your kingdom.
You will have your city but it is already vacated due to the continuous Persian attacks.
You will be in your full armor, with a few left troops and you will have to battle the persistent and ruthless oncoming Persians.

As usual please do share your feedback, concerns and bugs in discussions or on the discord.

Thanks

Mani
